evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: Ordinal acne severity grading requires distinguishing visually similar neighboring grades while jointly weighing holistic facial appearance and localized lesion burden - evidence that most existing approaches collapse into a single opaque representation.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: On a widely used benchmark, this fusion yields a clear, statistically supported improvement over global-evidence-only baselines, with the largest gains on the most severe cases.
